mainTopic: שמואל's rulings on which חליצה frees the צרות (sisters, a woman who got a גט, a woman who got a מאמר), and whether they rest on אין זיקה or on a weak זיקה that cannot make a צרה like an ערוה.
overview: The גמרא finishes testing שמואל's ruling that one brother does חליצה for all of the sisters. It gives two answers: 'all' really means the middle sister, or a valid חליצה is needed only to free a צרה, not the woman herself. Next it quotes שמואל's full statement. חליצה with the sisters, with a woman who got a גט, or with a woman who got a מאמר does not free her צרה, but חליצה with the צרה frees her. The גמרא asks why the צרות' חליצה frees the sisters, since the צרות seem linked through זיקה too. One answer says שמואל ruled according to the view that there is no זיקה. That answer needs more fixing: the plural 'צרות' is general wording, and the order of the חליצות matters. רב אשי instead says there is זיקה, but it is too weak to make a צרה like an ערוה, and a ברייתא seems to support him. רבי אבא בר ממל pushes back: the ברייתא may follow בית שמאי, together with רבי יוחנן בן נורי's enactment that צרות only do חליצה, which later חכמים completed. The amud ends by opening a new question that continues on the next amud.

steps.title: Why let one brother do an invalid חליצה when the other could do a valid one?
steps.stepSummary: Based on שמואל's rule that חליצה with the sisters does not free the צרות, the גמרא asks why one brother should do an invalid חליצה when the other brother could do a valid one.
steps.simpleTranslation: שמואל said: if he did חליצה with the sisters, the צרות are not freed. So in a case where שמעון's חליצה could be a valid one, should ראובן do an invalid חליצה with her?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes a ruling of שמואל showing he needs a valid חליצה. It then uses that ruling to attack his other ruling that one brother does חליצה for all the sisters.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once a brother does חליצה with one sister, the other sisters are now sisters of a woman tied to him, so he could never do יבום with them, and his חליצה with them is 'invalid'. The other brother has no such problem, so his חליצה would be valid. Since שמואל cares about valid חליצה, why does he let the first brother keep going?

keyTerms.meaning: A valid חליצה, done by a brother who could have done יבום with her
An invalid חליצה, done by a brother who could not have done יבום with her
Co-wives: the other wives of the same dead husband
Sisters

steps.confusionAlert: ראובן and שמעון are not real people here. They are placeholder names for the two living brothers.

phrases.english: If he performed חליצה with the sisters, the rival wives are not exempt.
Where שמעון's חליצה is available
as a valid חליצה,
should ראובן perform an invalid חליצה with her?
phrases.notes: ראובן is the brother who already did חליצה with one sister. שמעון is the brother who hasn't done any yet.

steps.triggerLanguage: היכא דקיימא חליצה דשמעון חליצה כשרה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the challenge from the previous section against שמואל's ruling 'אחד חולץ לכולן'.
steps.kashyaTarget: שמואל's ruling that one brother does חליצה for all of the sisters
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: שמואל requires a valid חליצה, as his sisters ruling shows. So he should not allow an invalid חליצה when a valid one is available from the other brother.

steps.title: 'One does חליצה for all' only means the middle sister
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא reinterprets שמואל: 'one does חליצה for all of them' refers only to the middle sister.
steps.simpleTranslation: What does 'one does חליצה for all of them,' which שמואל also said, mean? It refers to the middle one.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge by reading שמואל's words more narrowly. 'For all of them' really just means the middle sister.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the words only describe the middle sister, then שמואל never said that one brother does every חליצה. The challenge was built on reading 'all of them' as every single sister, so this narrower reading removes it.

keyTerms.meaning: One brother does חליצה for all of them (שמואל's earlier wording)
The middle one

phrases.english: What is the meaning of 'one performs חליצה for all of them'
that he also said?
It refers to the middle one.
phrases.notes: The middle sister is the one who is left after each brother has done חליצה with one sister.

steps.triggerLanguage: מאי אחד חולץ לכולן נמי דקאמר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge in step 1.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Reinterpreting the scope of שמואל's words
steps.terutzHavaAmina: 'For all of them' meant one brother does every חליצה, including invalid ones.
steps.terutzMaskana: שמואל only meant that one of the brothers does חליצה with the middle sister.

steps.title: But שמואל said 'all of them'
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא objects that the word 'all' does not fit an answer about only one sister.
steps.simpleTranslation: But he said 'all of them'!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back on the answer. שמואל clearly said 'all,' so how can it mean just one sister?
steps.deeperAnalysis: The attack is on the wording. A reading that limits 'all of them' to a single woman seems to go against the plain words.

keyTerms.meaning: But look! (opens a challenge)
All of them

phrases.english: But he said 'all of them'!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the answer in step 2.
steps.kashyaTarget: The reading that 'one does חליצה for all' means only the middle sister
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The word 'all' cannot naturally describe a single sister.

steps.title: Most of the חליצות are with him, so it is called 'all'
steps.stepSummary: Since one brother ends up doing most of the חליצות, שמואל calls it 'all of them'.
steps.simpleTranslation: Since most of them are with him, he calls it 'all of them.'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains why the word 'all' still fits. The brother who does חליצה for the middle sister has done most of the חליצות, so it is loosely called 'all.'
steps.deeperAnalysis: With three sisters, a brother who does two of the three חליצות has done the majority. שמואל used 'all' as loose speech for 'most,' so the narrow reading from step 2 stands.

keyTerms.meaning: The majority
With him
He calls it

phrases.english: Since the majority is with him,
phrases.notes: He means most of the חליצות are done by this one brother.

phrases.english: he calls it 'all of them.'

steps.triggerLanguage: כיון דרובה גביה קרי ליה כולן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the objection in step 3, defending step 2.
steps.terutzMaskana: 'All' here means most, since one brother does most of the חליצות.

steps.title: A valid חליצה is needed only to free a צרה
steps.stepSummary: A second answer: שמואל needs a valid חליצה only to free a צרה. To free the woman herself, even an invalid חליצה works.
steps.simpleTranslation: Or, if you want, say: when שמואל said we need a full חליצה, that is only to free her צרה. But to free herself, it does free her.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives a different answer to the challenge in step 1. It limits when שמואל demands a fully valid חליצה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The sisters ruling is about freeing the צרות through the sister's חליצה, and that needs a valid חליצה. In the case of the sisters falling to two brothers, each חליצה only needs to free the woman herself. So even an invalid חליצה by the same brother is good enough, and שמואל's words can keep their plain meaning.

keyTerms.meaning: And if you want, say (introduces another answer)
A full, top-quality חליצה
To free her co-wife
Herself

steps.whatToRemember: There are two answers for שמואל. (1) 'All' means the middle sister, and most of the חליצות are with one brother. (2) A valid חליצה is needed only to free a צרה; any חליצה frees the woman herself.
steps.whyThisMatters: This answer sets up a lasting distinction: freeing the woman herself versus freeing her צרה through her חליצה.

phrases.english: And if you wish, say:
When שמואל said
we require a full-fledged חליצה,
that applies only to exempt her rival wife,
but to exempt herself, it does exempt her.

steps.triggerLanguage: ואיבעית אימא כי קאמר שמואל חליצה מעליא בעינן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A second, independent answer to the challenge in step 1.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limiting the scope of the source rule
steps.terutzHavaAmina: שמואל requires a valid חליצה in every case.
steps.terutzMaskana: A valid חליצה is required only to free a צרה; an invalid one still frees the woman herself.

steps.title: שמואל's full ruling: the sisters and the צרות
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא now quotes שמואל's statement in full. חליצה with the sisters does not free the צרות, but חליצה with the צרות frees the sisters.
steps.simpleTranslation: Now to the statement itself. שמואל said: if he did חליצה with the sisters, the צרות are not freed. If he did it with the צרות, the sisters are freed.
steps.whatsHappening: Having used part of שמואל's statement, the גמרא now goes back and quotes the whole statement so it can study it. This is the first of three cases.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The sisters could never have had יבום with him, since each is the sister of a woman tied to him, so their חליצה is invalid and cannot free others. The צרות are not limited this way, so their חליצה is valid and frees everyone, including the sisters.

keyTerms.meaning: The matter itself: the גמרא returns to study a statement it quoted earlier
They are exempt (freed)

steps.confusionAlert: This repeats the line from step 1 on purpose. Here the גמרא is quoting it as part of שמואל's full statement.

phrases.english: The matter itself.
שמואל said:
If he performed חליצה with the sisters, the rival wives are not exempt;
if with the rival wives, the sisters are exempt.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Returns to quote in full the statement cited in step 1.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: An invalid חליצה, like one with the sisters, does not free the צרות. A valid חליצה with a צרה frees the sisters.

steps.title: The woman who received a גט and her צרה
steps.stepSummary: If he did חליצה with the woman who received a גט, her צרה is not freed. If he did it with the צרה, the woman with the גט is freed.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he did חליצה with the woman who received a גט, the צרה is not freed. If he did it with the צרה, the woman who received the גט is freed.
steps.whatsHappening: שמואל gives a second case that works like the sisters. Here the יבם first gave one of the women a גט.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once he gave her a גט, he can no longer do יבום with her, so her חליצה does not count as a full חליצה and cannot free her צרה. A חליצה with the צרה does free the woman who got the גט.

keyTerms.meaning: The woman who received a גט from the יבם
A co-wife (singular)

phrases.aramaic: חָלַץ לְבַעֲלַת הַגֵּט — לֹא נִפְטְרָה צָרָה,
phrases.english: If he performed חליצה with the woman who received the bill of divorce, the rival wife is not exempt;
if with the rival wife, the woman who received the bill of divorce is exempt.

steps.triggerLanguage: חלץ לבעלת הגט לא נפטרה צרה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues שמואל's statement with a second case.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: חליצה with the woman who received a גט does not free her צרה. חליצה with the צרה frees her.

steps.title: The woman who received a מאמר and her צרה
steps.stepSummary: If he did חליצה with the woman who received his מאמר, her צרה is not freed. If he did it with the צרה, the woman with the מאמר is freed.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he did חליצה with the woman who received a מאמר, the צרה is not freed. If he did it with the צרה, the woman who received the מאמר is freed.
steps.whatsHappening: שמואל gives a third case following the same pattern. Here the יבם first did a מאמר, a kind of יבום-engagement, with one of the women.
steps.deeperAnalysis: After a מאמר she also needs a גט, so חליצה alone is not a complete release for her and cannot free her צרה. A חליצה with the צרה works and frees the woman who received the מאמר.

keyTerms.meaning: A rabbinic engagement-like act a יבם does before יבום
The woman who received the יבם's מאמר

steps.whatToRemember: שמואל's pattern: חליצה with a woman whose חליצה is not fully valid (a sister, one who got a גט, one who got a מאמר) does not free her צרה. חליצה with the צרה frees her.

phrases.aramaic: חָלַץ לְבַעֲלַת הַמַּאֲמָר — לֹא נִפְטְרָה צָרָה.
phrases.english: If he performed חליצה with the woman who received the levirate betrothal, the rival wife is not exempt.
If with the rival wife, the woman who received the levirate betrothal is exempt.

steps.triggerLanguage: חלץ לבעלת המאמר לא נפטרה צרה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues שמואל's statement with a third case.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: חליצה with the woman who received a מאמר does not free her צרה. חליצה with the צרה frees her.

steps.title: Why treat the sisters and the rival wives differently?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא explains why חליצה with a sister does not free the צרות, then challenges that the same reasoning should block the צרות from freeing the sisters.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is different about the sisters, that the rival wives are not freed? It is because each sister is the sister of a woman tied to him by זיקה. But then, if he did חליצה with the rival wives, the sisters should not be freed either, since the rival wives are rival wives of the sister of a woman tied to him by זיקה!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא first gives the reason for שמואל's ruling about the sisters. Then it attacks: that same reason seems to apply to the צרות too.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A sister is the sister of a woman bound to the יבם by זיקה, so she counts as forbidden to him. That makes her חליצה weak, and it cannot free her צרה. But the צרה is the rival wife of that same forbidden sister, so her חליצה should be just as weak. Why, then, does it free the sisters?

keyTerms.meaning: What is the difference? A question asking why two cases get different rulings
The bond between the יבם and his dead brother's widow before יבום or חליצה
A wife's sister, who is forbidden to the husband
Rival wives, meaning the other wives of the same husband

phrases.english: What is different about the sisters
that the rival wives are not freed?
Because she is, [compared to her],
phrases.notes: Some versions say 'to him' (round brackets), and the corrected wording says 'to her' (square brackets).

phrases.english: the sister of a woman tied to him by זיקה.
Then if he did חליצה with the rival wives too,
the sisters should not be freed,
because they are the rival wives
of the sister of a woman tied to him by זיקה!

steps.triggerLanguage: מַאי שְׁנָא לַאֲחָיוֹת דְּלֹא נִפְטְרוּ צָרוֹת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Questions the logic behind שמואל's ruling quoted in step 6
steps.kashyaTarget: שמואל's ruling that חליצה with the צרות frees the sisters
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If the sister's link through זיקה makes her חליצה weak, the צרה is linked the same way, so her חליצה should also be weak

steps.title: שמואל holds there is no real זיקה
steps.stepSummary: שמואל holds that זיקה does not create a real link, so the צרות are not forbidden.
steps.simpleTranslation: שמואל holds: there is no real זיקה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that שמואל holds there is no real זיקה at all, so the צרות are not linked to the יבם and their חליצה is valid.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If זיקה does not create a real marriage-like link, the צרות are not treated as related to the יבם. So their חליצה is fully valid and frees the sisters.

keyTerms.meaning: He holds, meaning this is his view
The bond is not strong enough to count like a marriage

phrases.english: שמואל holds: there is no real זיקה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge in step 9
steps.terutzResolutionType: Identifies the underlying opinion behind the ruling
steps.terutzHavaAmina: זיקה creates a link that makes the צרות forbidden too
steps.terutzMaskana: Under the view that there is no real זיקה, the צרות are not forbidden, so their חליצה works

steps.title: But שמואל said there is זיקה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא points out that שמואל himself said elsewhere that there is זיקה.
steps.simpleTranslation: But didn't שמואל say there is זיקה?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the answer: שמואל is known to hold the opposite view.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The answer in step 10 depends on שמואל holding אין זיקה. But elsewhere he ruled יש זיקה, so the answer seems to contradict his own words.

keyTerms.meaning: But surely, an opening for a challenge
The bond is strong, almost like a marriage

phrases.english: But didn't שמואל say there is זיקה!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the answer of step 10
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that שמואל holds אין זיקה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: שמואל explicitly said יש זיקה elsewhere, which contradicts this

steps.title: שמואל spoke according to the other view
steps.stepSummary: שמואל gave this ruling according to the view that there is no זיקה, even though he does not hold that way himself.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said it according to the one who says there is no זיקה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that שמואל was explaining how things work under the other opinion. It was not his own view.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A חכם sometimes rules within a system he does not accept. Here שמואל tells us what the law would be for someone who holds אין זיקה. That removes the contradiction.

keyTerms.meaning: According to the one who says
He is saying

phrases.english: He is speaking according to the one who says there is no זיקה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the contradiction raised in step 11
steps.terutzResolutionType: Ruling given according to another opinion
steps.terutzHavaAmina: שמואל's ruling reflects his own view
steps.terutzMaskana: The ruling follows the view of אין זיקה, which is not שמואל's own position

steps.title: Then the first sister's rival wife should be freed
steps.stepSummary: If there is no זיקה, only the second sister's חליצה is invalid, so the first sister's צרה should be freed.
steps.simpleTranslation: If so, when he did חליצה with the sisters, why are the rival wives not freed? We can understand that רחל's rival wife is not freed. Once he did חליצה with לאה and then did חליצה with רחל, רחל's חליצה is an invalid חליצה. But לאה's rival wife should be freed!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a new question based on the view of אין זיקה. That view explains one צרה staying bound, but not both.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Without זיקה, the first sister (לאה) is not forbidden, so her חליצה is valid and should free her צרה. Only the second sister (רחל) becomes forbidden, because she is now the sister of a woman he already did חליצה with. So her חליצה is invalid. Yet שמואל said 'צרות' are not freed, which sounds like both.

keyTerms.meaning: If so
It is understandable that..., followed by a part that is hard to understand
An invalid חליצה, which cannot free a צרה
Names used for the first and second sister

steps.confusionAlert: לאה and רחל are just names for 'the first sister' and 'the second sister'. Whichever one gets חליצה first counts as לאה.

phrases.english: If so, when he did חליצה with the sisters,
why are the rival wives not freed?
It makes sense that רחל's rival wife is not freed,
because once he did חליצה with לאה,
and then did חליצה with רחל,
רחל's חליצה turns out to be
an invalid חליצה.
But לאה's rival wife should be freed!

steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Under אין זיקה, the first sister's חליצה is valid, so at least her צרה should be freed

steps.title: It refers only to רחל's rival wife
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא explains that 'the rival wives are not freed' means only the second sister's צרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: What does 'the rival wives are not freed', which he said, mean? It refers to רחל's rival wife.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא narrows שמואל's words so that they speak only about the צרה of the second sister.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This agrees with the logic of step 13. לאה's צרה is freed, and only רחל's צרה stays bound, because רחל's חליצה was invalid.

keyTerms.meaning: About the rival wife
Also

phrases.english: What does 'the rival wives are not freed' mean,
which he also said?
It refers to רחל's rival wife.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 13 by narrowing שמואל's words
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limiting the scope of the statement
steps.terutzMaskana: Only the second sister's (רחל's) צרה stays bound

steps.title: But he said 'rival wives' in the plural
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא objects that שמואל used the plural 'צרות', which sounds like more than one.
steps.simpleTranslation: But he said 'rival wives'!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the narrowing: the plural word does not seem to fit just one צרה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If only רחל's צרה is meant, שמואל should have said 'צרה' in the singular. The plural suggests both צרות are bound.

keyTerms.meaning: He said 'rival wives', in the plural

phrases.english: But he said 'rival wives'!

steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that only רחל's צרה is meant
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The plural form implies more than one צרה

steps.title: The plural means rival wives in general
steps.stepSummary: The plural 'צרות' describes the general rule for all such cases. It does not mean both צרות in one case.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rival wives in general.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the plural is a general way of stating the rule, covering every case like this.
steps.deeperAnalysis: שמואל was stating a rule for all such cases everywhere, so he used the plural. In any single case, only the second sister's צרה stays bound.

keyTerms.meaning: In general, of the world at large

steps.whatToRemember: According to the view of אין זיקה, שמואל's ruling works like this. חליצה with the צרות frees the sisters. With the sisters, only the first sister's חליצה is valid, so only the second sister's (רחל's) צרה stays bound. The plural 'צרות' is just general wording.

phrases.english: Rival wives in general.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the wording challenge of step 15. The next step builds on this answer and attacks the second half of שמואל's ruling.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Rereading the plural as a general statement
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The plural means both צרות in one case
steps.terutzMaskana: The plural describes the rule in general, and only רחל's צרה stays bound in each case

steps.title: How can רחל be freed through her rival wife's חליצה?
steps.stepSummary: Based on the last answer, the גמרא attacks the second half of שמואל's ruling. A צרה whose חליצה should free רחל is forbidden as 'the צרה of a relative of his חלוצה.'
steps.simpleTranslation: If so, look at שמואל's words: 'If he did חליצה with the rival wives, the sisters are freed.' Can רחל really be freed through her rival wife's חליצה? We learned in a משנה that a man is forbidden to the rival wife of a relative of his חלוצה!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא accepts the idea that שמואל is talking about the second sister's case. Now it shows a problem with the other half of his ruling.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once one sister, לאה, has had חליצה, the other sister's צרה becomes 'the צרה of a relative of his חלוצה.' A משנה says that woman is forbidden to him. A forbidden woman's חליצה does not count, so it should not free רחל.

keyTerms.meaning: If so: if we accept what was just said
The rival wife of a relative of the woman he did חליצה with
She is freed (from יבום)
But didn't we learn (in a משנה)?

phrases.english: If so:
'If he performed חליצה with the rival wives, the sisters are freed'
but would she be freed through the rival wife of Rachel?
But didn't we learn in a משנה:
A man is forbidden to the rival wife of a relative of his חלוצה!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Builds on the answer in step 16 and attacks the second clause of שמואל's ruling.
steps.kashyaTarget: שמואל's clause 'חלץ לצרות נפטרו אחיות', as explained in steps 14–16
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רחל's צרה is forbidden as צרת קרובת חלוצתו, so her חליצה is not valid and cannot free רחל.

steps.title: It depends on whom he did חליצה with first
steps.stepSummary: שמואל's ruling depends on the order. If he started with a sister, he cannot finish with a צרה. If he started with a צרה, he can finish even with a sister.
steps.simpleTranslation: שמואל too is talking about who he started with. If he started with the sisters, he may not finish with the rival wives, because a man is forbidden to the rival wife of a relative of his חלוצה. If he started with the rival wives, he may finish even with the sisters, because a man is allowed to marry the relative of the rival wife of his חלוצה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that שמואל's two clauses describe two different orders of חליצה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the first חליצה was with לאה herself, רחל's צרה is a 'צרה of a relative of his חלוצה' and is forbidden. If the first חליצה was with לאה's צרה, then רחל is only 'a relative of the צרה of his חלוצה.' That woman is permitted, so her חליצה is valid. So 'חלץ לצרות נפטרו אחיות' means: when he started with a צרה.

keyTerms.meaning: Whom he started with: which woman got חליצה first
He may not finish (the second חליצה with her)
A relative of the rival wife of his חלוצה. She is permitted.

steps.confusionAlert: The two phrases sound almost the same but are opposite. 'צרת קרובת חלוצתו' (the צרה of his חלוצה's relative) is forbidden. 'קרובת צרת חלוצתו' (the relative of his חלוצה's צרה) is permitted.

phrases.english: Shmuel too
is speaking about 'he began' and 'he did not begin':
phrases.notes: He means it matters which woman got חליצה first.

phrases.english: if he began with the sisters
he may not finish with the rival wives,
as we learned: a man is forbidden
to the rival wife of a relative of his חלוצה.
If he began with the rival wives
he may finish even with the sisters.
As we learned: a man is permitted
to the relative of the rival wife of his חלוצה.

steps.triggerLanguage: שְׁמוּאֵל נָמֵי, הִתְחִיל וְלֹא הִתְחִיל קָאָמַר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא of step 17 by explaining that the two clauses describe different orders of חליצה.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Redefining the case: the ruling depends on the order of the חליצות
steps.terutzHavaAmina: שמואל's second clause means any חליצה with a צרה frees the sister, even after a sister already had חליצה.
steps.terutzMaskana: The second clause applies only when the first חליצה was with a צרה. Then the sister is only קרובת צרת חלוצתו, who is permitted, so her חליצה works.

steps.title: רב אשי: שמואל holds there is זיקה, but זיקה cannot make a צרה like an ערוה
steps.stepSummary: רב אשי goes back to the original idea that שמואל holds there is a זיקה. The צרות' חליצה still frees the sisters, because זיקה is not strong enough to make a צרה like an ערוה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אשי said: Really, it is as you said at first. The reason is that זיקה is not strong enough to make a rival wife like an ערוה.
steps.whatsHappening: רב אשי offers a different way to explain שמואל. He says שמואל's ruling follows his own view that there is a זיקה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Earlier, the גמרא moved away from 'יש זיקה' because then the צרות should be forbidden, like the sisters. רב אשי answers that זיקה can forbid the sister herself, but it is too weak to forbid her צרה as if she were an ערוה. So the צרות' חליצה is valid and frees the sisters. The sisters' חליצה still does not free the צרות.

keyTerms.meaning: Actually, it is as you said (at first)
The יבום bond between the יבם and the widow, before יבום or חליצה
It is not strong enough
A woman forbidden as a close relative

steps.whyThisMatters: This gives a middle position. זיקה is real, but it has limits: it does not reach far enough to make a צרה forbidden like an ערוה.

phrases.english: Rav Ashi said:
Actually, it is as you said,
phrases.notes: He means the first idea, that שמואל holds there is a זיקה, which the גמרא set aside back in step 10.

phrases.english: and it is because the זיקה is not strong enough
to make the rival wife like an ערוה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives a different answer to the question of step 9. Instead of the 'no זיקה' approach of steps 10–18, he keeps the original assumption that שמואל holds there is זיקה.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limiting the strength of a legal concept (זיקה)
steps.terutzHavaAmina: If there is a זיקה, the צרות would be as forbidden as the sisters, and their חליצה could not free the sisters.
steps.terutzMaskana: זיקה forbids the sister but is too weak to make her צרה like an ערוה. So the צרות' חליצה is valid.

steps.title: A ברייתא supports רב אשי
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא says the sisters' חליצה does not free the צרות, which implies the צרות' חליצה does free the sisters. The best reason for this is רב אשי's idea.
steps.simpleTranslation: A ברייתא supports רב אשי. It says: if he did חליצה with the sisters, the rival wives are not freed. That implies that if he did חליצה with the rival wives, the sisters are freed. Why? Isn't it because the ברייתא holds there is a זיקה, but the זיקה is not strong enough to make the rival wife like an ערוה?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא with the same ruling as שמואל and shows that its reasoning matches רב אשי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ברייתא treats the two cases differently. The sisters' חליצה does not free the צרות, which shows זיקה exists. The צרות' חליצה does free the sisters, which shows זיקה does not make a צרה into an ערוה. That is exactly רב אשי's position.

keyTerms.meaning: It is taught in a ברייתא in support of him
This implies (an inference from the wording)
What is the reason?
Is it not because…? (pointing to the likely reason)

steps.whatToRemember: The sisters' חליצה does not free the צרות, but the צרות' חליצה frees the sisters. According to רב אשי and the ברייתא, the reason is that זיקה exists but cannot make a צרה like an ערוה.

phrases.english: It is taught in a ברייתא in line with Rav Ashi:
If he performed חליצה with the sisters
the rival wives are not freed.
This implies: with the rival wives
the sisters are freed.
What is the reason?
Is it not because he holds there is a זיקה,
and the זיקה is not strong enough
to make the rival wife like an ערוה?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings a ברייתא to support רב אשי's approach from step 19.
steps.raayaObject: רב אשי's position that there is זיקה, but it cannot make a צרה like an ערוה
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא: חלץ לאחיות לא נפטרו צרות, which implies that חליצה with the צרות frees the sisters

steps.title: רבי אבא בר ממל: The ברייתא follows בית שמאי
steps.stepSummary: רבי אבא בר ממל says the ברייתא from step 20 follows בית שמאי, who permit צרות to the brothers.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rabbi Abba bar Memel said: Whose view is this ברייתא? It is בית שמאי's. We learned in a משנה: בית שמאי permit the rival wives to the brothers.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אבא בר ממל gives a different explanation of the ברייתא from step 20. He says it does not need רב אשי's reasoning, because it follows בית שמאי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In step 20, the ברייתא seemed to support רב אשי, who said a זיקה is too weak to make a צרה forbidden. רבי אבא בר ממל says there is a simpler reason. בית שמאי allow even the צרה of a real ערוה to the brothers, so a צרה tied only through a זיקה is surely allowed.

keyTerms.meaning: Whose opinion is this? A phrase used to find out which תנא a source follows.
The school of שמאי, which often argues with בית הלל
Co-wives of the same husband

steps.confusionAlert: Don't mix up the two schools. Here it is בית שמאי, not בית הלל, who allow the צרות to the brothers. The normal הלכה follows בית הלל, who forbid them.

phrases.english: Rabbi Abba bar Memel said:
Whose view is this? It is Beit Shammai's.
As we learned in a Mishnah:
Beit Shammai permit the rival wives to the brothers.
phrases.notes: This means even the צרה of a woman who is an ערוה to the brother may do יבום with him.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives a different reason for the ברייתא cited in step 20, so the ברייתא no longer has to prove רב אשי's idea.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Assigns the ברייתא to a specific תנא (בית שמאי)
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ברייתא can only be explained with רב אשי's idea that זיקה is too weak to forbid a צרה.
steps.terutzMaskana: The ברייתא may simply follow בית שמאי, who allow צרות to the brothers anyway.

steps.title: If it is בית שמאי, why not יבום too?
steps.stepSummary: If the ברייתא follows בית שמאי, the צרה should also be allowed to do יבום, not just חליצה.
steps.simpleTranslation: If so, she should be able to do יבום as well!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges רבי אבא בר ממל's explanation. If בית שמאי fully allow the צרה, why does the ברייתא mention only חליצה?
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to בית שמאי, the צרה is fully allowed to the brother, so she could even marry him through יבום. The ברייתא speaks only about חליצה, which suggests it does not fit בית שמאי.

keyTerms.meaning: If so. Used to show a problem that follows from the last idea.
Marriage of the brother's widow by the surviving brother

phrases.english: If so,
she should also be allowed to do yibum!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks רבי אבא בר ממל's claim that the ברייתא follows בית שמאי.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי אבא בר ממל's claim that the ברייתא is בית שמאי
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: בית שמאי fully permit the צרה, so the ברייתא should allow יבום, yet it only mentions חליצה.

steps.title: It follows רבי יוחנן בן נורי's enactment of חליצה only
steps.stepSummary: The ruling follows רבי יוחנן בן נורי, who made an enactment that צרות do חליצה and not יבום.
steps.simpleTranslation: It follows רבי יוחנן בן נורי, who said: Come, let us make an enactment for the rival wives, that they do חליצה and not יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question. The ברייתא follows רבי יוחנן בן נורי, who said the צרות should only do חליצה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יוחנן בן נורי wanted to avoid the argument between בית שמאי and בית הלל. With חליצה only, the צרה is released according to both views. She does not do יבום, which בית הלל forbid. That explains why the ברייתא mentions only חליצה.

keyTerms.meaning: Let us make an enactment (a rabbinic תקנה)
They do חליצה

phrases.english: It follows Rabbi Yochanan ben Nuri,
who said: Come, let us make an enactment for the rival wives
that they do chalitza and not yibum.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 22 by narrowing the ruling to רבי יוחנן בן נורי's enactment.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Pins the ruling to a specific enactment
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Following בית שמאי, the צרה should be able to do יבום.
steps.terutzMaskana: Because of רבי יוחנן בן נורי's enactment, צרות do only חליצה, so the ברייתא mentions only חליצה.

steps.title: But the enactment was never completed
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא objects that רבי יוחנן בן נורי's enactment was never finished, because troubled times came.
steps.simpleTranslation: But the Master said: They did not manage to finish the matter before the times became troubled!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the last answer. There is a known teaching that רבי יוחנן בן נורי's enactment was never finished.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the enactment was never put in place, a ברייתא cannot be built on it. So the explanation of step 23 seems to fall apart.

keyTerms.meaning: But the Master said. Brings a known teaching as a challenge.
The times became troubled (persecution or hard decrees)

phrases.english: But the Master said:
they did not manage to finish the matter
before the times became troubled!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהָאָמַר מָר: לָא הִסְפִּיקוּ לִגְמוֹר אֶת הַדָּבָר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the answer of step 23 by saying the enactment never took effect.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that the ברייתא follows רבי יוחנן בן נורי's enactment
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: An enactment that was never finished cannot be the basis of a ruling.

steps.title: Later חכמים finished the enactment
steps.stepSummary: רב נחמן בר יצחק answers that after רבי יוחנן בן נורי's time, the חכמים went back and made the enactment.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב נחמן בר יצחק said: After him, they went back and made the enactment.
steps.whatsHappening: רב נחמן בר יצחק answers the challenge. The enactment was not finished in רבי יוחנן בן נורי's time, but later חכמים finished it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both teachings are true. The work stopped in the troubled times, and later it was completed. So the ברייתא can follow the enactment, and רבי אבא בר ממל's explanation stands.

keyTerms.meaning: After him, they went back and made the enactment

steps.whatToRemember: There are two ways to explain the ברייתא: רב אשי's idea that זיקה is too weak to forbid a צרה, or רבי אבא בר ממל's view that it follows בית שמאי together with רבי יוחנן בן נורי's חליצה-only enactment, which later חכמים completed.

phrases.english: Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said:
After him, they went back and made the enactment.
phrases.notes: "After him" means after רבי יוחנן בן נורי's time; later חכמים finished what he started.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 24 and saves the explanation of step 23.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Historical clarification: the enactment was finished later
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The enactment was never completed, so it cannot be the basis of a ruling.
steps.terutzMaskana: Later חכמים completed the enactment, so the ברייתא can follow it.

steps.title: A new question is raised
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא opens a new question with the phrase איבעיא להו.
steps.simpleTranslation: A question was asked of them:
steps.whatsHappening: This line is only a setup. The גמרא is starting a new question, which comes in the next part of the text.
steps.deeperAnalysis: איבעיא להו marks a real question the חכמים were unsure about. Here it starts a new topic connected to שמואל's ruling about a woman who received a גט and a woman who received מאמר. The question itself comes next.

keyTerms.meaning: A question was asked of them. Opens a real question the חכמים were unsure about.

phrases.english: A question was asked of them:

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Ends the previous discussion and opens a new question.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The question itself comes in the next part of the text; this line only introduces it.
